title: Trump's NATO Pressure Campaign Intensifies as Ankara Summit Opens
detail: On the eve of the NATO Leaders' Summit in Ankara, President Trump signaled he would press allies hard on defense spending and burden-sharing, with commentators warning the alliance was at a 'breaking point' amid US threats to reduce its European military footprint. NATO leaders were set to affirm record defense spending increases as the US simultaneously advanced plans for a further European troop drawdown.

media.caption: NATO leaders gather in Ankara as US threatens European drawdown
